item.title: Who is Jay Mehta? Meet Juhi Chawla’s husband selling half of his 45% KKR stake for $400 million
item.description: Jay Mehta, husband of actor Juhi Chawla and a director of the Mehta Group, is reportedly set to sell half of his 45% stake in Kolkata Knight Riders to US-based Ares Management for $400 million. item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's FDA suspends licences of Blinkit, Chaayos, 5 Spice among 6 Mumbai establishments: What inspection found
